headline: A federal law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Monroeville, Pennsylvania, as the Henry Parham VA Clinic.
what_it_does: The law gives a new name to the community-based outpatient clinic that the Department of Veterans Affairs runs in Monroeville, Pennsylvania. The new name is the Henry Parham VA Clinic. The law does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or hours.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025.
